name: Funk Band
spec: Guitar, bass and drums, with a horn or keys at quartet size
alt: A row of level meters lit up in mustard and cream on a teal field, drawn flat, with the words funk band above them.
_merged_note: MERGED 2026-08-16 from two listings, 'Dan Steele (funk trio)' and 'DF Funk'. The workbook flagged the direct overlap and said pick one or merge; Daniel's ruling is that they are interchangeable, so this is one format with both behind it as availability depth. The first pass differentiated them on voice-fronted versus guitar-fronted, which rested on a face chair the workbook marks 'assumed'. That copy is gone and is not to be reinstated without confirming the chair.
blurb: Instrumental funk and soul covers for a party where the dance floor is close to the tables. It books as a trio of guitar, bass and drums, or as a quartet with a horn or keys when the floor wants more.
_name_note: RENAMED 2026-09-23 from 'Funk Trio to quartet', which was a size range wearing a name. config_tags now carry both sizes the old name promised. The id stays funk-trio: it is in every ?act= link and the roster's data attributes.
_page_note: PAGE 2026-09-23: 'funk band denver' and 'funk band for hire' autocomplete, which is the demand evidence the skill asks for before a spec'd listing earns a page. Scaffolded with scripts/new_act_page.py --slug funk-band.
_img_note: 2026-09-23: its own drawn tile from scripts/format_art.py, replacing headliners.jpg, the interim snare-drum still that three party formats were sharing on the roster.
